name: Game Boy LCD
summary: Nintendo DMG handheld: a four-shade olive-green LCD, dot-matrix texture, chunky 4px pixels, hard edges, and Press Start 2P over VT323.
whenToUse: When the user asks for Game Boy, DMG, LCD, dot-matrix, monochrome-green, handheld console, or a 4-shade pixel-screen aesthetic.
rules: Four shades only: #9bbc0f, #8bac0f, #306230, #0f380f. Any new tone must come from paletteVariants (dmg, shadeRamp, pocket, nightInvert) — no opacity fades, no rgba() tints, no fifth green, because the LCD panel physically cannot render one.
Treat 4px as the pixel unit and 8px as the layout grid: borders, insets, rings, gaps, and icon strokes all snap to 4/8/12/16px — never 1px hairlines, 2px borders, or 3px insets.

The screen is a dot-matrix panel: overlay effects.dotMatrix at 100% cover with pointer-events: none, and render any imagery with image-rendering: pixelated at integer scale factors (2x, 3x, 4x) so no anti-aliased edge appears.

Elevate with hard offset shadows only, zero blur (4px 4px 0 #306230 for buttons and rows, 8px 8px 0 #306230 for hero panels); pressing an element translates it by the offset and collapses the shadow to 0 — the only tolerated blur is the 0 0 6px #8bac0f focus glow.

Use Press Start 2P for headings, buttons, and HUD labels only, uppercase and tracked 0.05em–0.15em, a few words per string; set all body copy, table cells, and input values in VT323 at 20px/1.4 minimum — the 8px pixel face collapses at paragraph length.

Encode state by inversion and position, not by hue: a selected row swaps to background #0f380f with text #9bbc0f, and every swapped state also carries a visible marker (a » caret, a bold label, or the word ACTIVE).
Animate discretely in steps(): steps(4, end) for sprite nudges, steps(2, jump-none) 1s infinite for the caret, and 0ms/120ms/240ms/1000ms durations — no ease, no linear tween, no animated blur.
Keep the handheld frame: content lives inside a #8bac0f bezel with the four-shade screen inset, a status line runs along the bottom, and nothing floats outside that bezel or overlaps its edge.

componentRecipes.card: background:#9bbc0f;border:4px solid #0f380f;border-radius:0;padding:16px 24px;color:#0f380f;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px #8bac0f,4px 4px 0 #306230; title = Press Start 2P 10px uppercase #0f380f with a 4px #306230 underline that stops one grid step short; body = VT323 20px/1.4 #0f380f; footer actions are 4px-bordered buttons; the dotMatrix overlay sits inside at 100% cover with pointer-events none.
componentRecipes.select: A monochrome menu row, not a popover: trigger = VT323 20px field (background:#8bac0f;border:4px solid #306230;padding:8px 12px;color:#0f380f) with a blinking '▼'; the open list is a 4px-ruled frame of Press Start 2P rows; the selected row inverts to background #0f380f / text #9bbc0f and prefixes '»'; hover shifts translate(-4px,-4px) with box-shadow 4px 4px 0 #306230.
componentRecipes.checkbox: A 24px square pixel well: background:#8bac0f;border:4px solid #306230;border-radius:0; checked = a 12px #0f380f block centred inside with a 4px #306230 focus ring; radio = a 12px #0f380f dot; label in VT323 20px #0f380f with the state word 'ON'/'OFF'; pressed state only changes position, never hue.
componentRecipes.badge: A 4px-bordered chip: display:inline-flex;gap:8px;padding:4px 10px;background:#8bac0f;border:4px solid;border-radius:0;font:10px/1 'Press Start 2P';text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em; role color = border+text in the four DMG shades only (#0f380f/#306230/#8bac0f/#9bbc0f) with the word spelled out; never a fifth shade.
componentRecipes.avatar: A 32px sprite tile: image-rendering:pixelated; background:#8bac0f;border:4px solid #0f380f;border-radius:0;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #306230; initials fall back to Press Start 2P 12px #0f380f; integer 2x/3x scale only, and the tile snaps to the 8px grid.
componentRecipes.nav: Horizontal HUD rail: items = Press Start 2P 12px uppercase #0f380f with 4px 16px padding and a 4px #306230 separator; hover inverts to #0f380f on #9bbc0f; the active tab inverts to background #0f380f / text #9bbc0f and prefixes a blinking '»'; the vertical form is the existing menu; no radius and no smooth motion.
componentRecipes.table: A 4px pixel grid: header = Press Start 2P 10px uppercase #0f380f on #8bac0f with a 4px #306230 bottom rule; body rows = VT323 20px/1.4 #0f380f on #9bbc0f separated by 4px #306230 rules; hover inverts the row, the selected row inverts to background #0f380f / text #9bbc0f and prefixes '»'; cell padding 8px 12px.
componentRecipes.dialog: A monochrome modal: background:#9bbc0f;border:4px solid #0f380f;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px #8bac0f,4px 4px 0 #306230; scrim = color-mix(in srgb, var(--overlay) 60%, transparent); title in Press Start 2P, body in VT323, actions are inverted 4px-bordered buttons; entrance is a 240ms steps(4) translate, reduced motion = instant.
componentRecipes.toast: A bottom-right LCD line: background:#8bac0f;border:4px solid;padding:10px 14px;font:VT323 20px/1.2; a 4px left accent in a DMG shade plus the word (OK/WARNING/!ERROR); auto-dismisses in 240ms by collapsing its 4px 4px 0 shadow to 0; reduced motion shows it statically.
componentRecipes.code: A monochrome block: background:#9bbc0f;border:4px solid #0f380f;border-radius:0;padding:16px;font:18px/1.4 'VT323';color:#0f380f; preserve whitespace; comments in #306230, strings in #0f380f, errors marked '!ERROR'; no syntax gradients and no fifth shade.
componentRecipes.empty: A centred LCD panel: an 8-bit sprite glyph drawn in 4px blocks, one VT323 message ('NO SAVES' / 'INSERT CARTRIDGE'), and a single inverted Press Start 2P button; the glyph is aria-hidden and the state is written in words.
componentRecipes.panel: background: #9bbc0f; border: 4px solid #0f380f; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px 24px; color: #0f380f; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #8bac0f, 4px 4px 0 #306230; — the inset ring is the LCD bezel step that separates the panel field from its frame; the dotMatrix overlay sits absolutely inside at 100% cover with pointer-events: none. Titles sit in the top-left corner as a Press Start 2P 10px uppercase label with a 4px #306230 underline rule that stops one grid step short of the right edge.
componentRecipes.button: font: 700 12px/1.4 'Press Start 2P'; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; background: #0f380f; color: #9bbc0f; border: 4px solid #0f380f; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 16px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #306230; transition: none; :hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #306230; } :active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #306230; } :focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #306230; outline-offset: 4px; } — secondary variant: #8bac0f background, #0f380f text, 4px #0f380f border; pressed buttons may not change hue, only position.
componentRecipes.input: background: #8bac0f; color: #0f380f; font: 20px/1.4 'VT323'; border: 4px solid #306230; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 12px; caret-color: #0f380f; box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 0 rgba(15,56,15,0.12); :placeholder { color: #306230; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-family: 'Press Start 2P'; font-size: 10px; } :focus { border-color: #0f380f; box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 0 rgba(15,56,15,0.16), 0 0 6px #8bac0f; outline: none; } — invalid state inverts the field to background #0f380f / color #9bbc0f and appends the literal text '!ERROR' in VT323, never a red border.
componentRecipes.statusbar: height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 0 16px; background: #8bac0f; border-top: 4px solid #0f380f; border-radius: 0; font: 10px/1 'Press Start 2P'; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #0f380f; segments split by border-left: 4px solid #306230; the live value inverts to a #0f380f block with #9bbc0f text, and the trailing state cell is an 8px wide #0f380f block animated with steps(2, jump-none) 1s infinite.
componentRecipes.menu: vertical list, no radius, no bullets: item { display: block; font: 12px/1.5 'Press Start 2P'; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 8px 16px 8px 32px; color: #0f380f; } selected item inverts to background #0f380f / color #9bbc0f and prefixes a blinking '»' in the same inverted field at steps(2, jump-none) 1s infinite; hover shifts translate(-4px, -4px) with box-shadow 4px 4px 0 #306230; group separators are 4px dashed #306230, never 1px hairlines, and no menu row may use a third shade.

copywriting.voice: Handheld cartridge manual: short, plain, quietly instructive. The machine names the action, shows the four-shade screen doing it, and stops — one instruction per line, present tense, no marketing adjective, no exclamation, and never a sentence a 1990s one-line LCD could not have shown.

case.body: sentence case in VT323 body copy; UPPERCASE for HUD labels, buttons, and menu rows

avoid: emoji and modern flat icon sets — signals are 8px pixel glyphs only
sentences longer than one LCD line in headings, buttons, or menus
apologetic or chatty system copy ('Oops', 'Sorry, one moment')
colour-coded status wording (green means good, red means bad) — say ERROR or OK in words
Press Start 2P for any string longer than a few words

do: Quantize every border, padding step, divider, and grid line to 4px or 8px so the pixel unit stays honest across components.
Keep the whole surface inside the four DMG shades and de-emphasize by swapping shades (#306230 for secondary text) rather than by opacity or rgba().
Give every interactive element a hard 4px offset shadow plus an instant pressed state that translates by the offset and collapses the shadow.
Overlay the dotMatrix pattern on large LCD fields and keep it off small text containers so 10px display type stays legible.
Set headings, buttons, and HUD labels in Press Start 2P uppercase at 0.05em–0.15em tracking, a few words per string; put every sentence in VT323.
Pair each inverted state with a glyph or word marker (», ACTIVE, !ERROR) so state never depends on shade alone.
Keep a persistent 32px status line with battery/level-style readouts so the screen always reads as a handheld device with chrome.
dont: No border-radius anywhere — 0 on buttons, inputs, panels, images, and avatars; corners are chamfered by removing whole 4px blocks, never rounded.
No fifth colour, no gradients on surfaces, no glow beyond the single 0 0 6px #8bac0f focus halo, and no blurred drop shadows.
No smooth motion: no ease-in-out, no cubic-bezier fades, no tweened colour or opacity transitions.
No Press Start 2P body copy: paragraphs, table cells, help text, and long values belong to VT323.
No modern colour signals (red danger, green success, blue links) — in a 4-shade panel those hues do not exist.
No 1px hairlines, 2px borders, or 3px insets; the smallest line weight in the system is 4px.
No anti-aliased or photographic imagery — every bitmap is pixel art scaled by an integer factor with image-rendering: pixelated.
accessibility: #0f380f on #9bbc0f clears 4.5:1 comfortably for body text, but #306230 on #8bac0f sits near the floor — reserve the mid shade for 16px-and-up secondary text, borders, and non-text signal, and never for a paragraph.
Press Start 2P only reads from 10px up with 1.4–1.6 line-height and a few words per line; VT323 carries all running text at 20px/1.4 minimum, with no fake bold, italic, or condensed weights.

Never encode state by shade or inversion alone — pair every swapped row, error field, and live value with a marker word or glyph (», ACTIVE, !ERROR) and keep a 4px focus ring visible at 4px offset on every focusable element.
Hold the mid-shade pairs at the same perceptual weight as the extremes: do not place #306230 text on #8bac0f panels, and keep the dotMatrix overlay under 16% opacity so glyph edges survive.

Honor prefers-reduced-motion: stop the blinking caret and status pulse, render the :active shadow collapse as an instant state change, and drop the dotMatrix drift — the screen must stay fully readable with all animation removed.
signatureElement: The four-shade LCD dot-matrix screen: an inverted-state HUD and hard-offset panels sitting under a repeating pixel grid inside the #8bac0f bezel

attribution.name: Nintendo Game Boy (DMG-01) four-shade LCD palette — community reference

prose.overview: Game Boy LCD renders the interface as a DMG handheld screen: a pale olive LCD field, four shades of green, a visible dot-matrix grid, and chunky 4px pixels that read as hardware output rather than drawn UI. Everything is quantized — a 4px pixel unit, an 8px layout grid, zero radius, stepped motion — and everything sits inside a #8bac0f bezel with a status line along the bottom. It should feel small, honest, and slightly grimy, like a screen viewed at an angle in daylight, never glossy or modern.
prose.colors: The palette is the panel itself: #9bbc0f as the lit field, #8bac0f one step down for bezels and inset surfaces, #306230 for secondary text, rules, and shadow offsets, and #0f380f as the only ink. There is no fifth colour, so emphasis is structural — inversion, weight, position, and the pattern of the dot grid — instead of chromatic. The paletteVariants carry the alternates honestly: dmg names the four shades, shadeRamp indexes them 0–3 for sprite work, pocket swaps in the greyscale ramp of the Game Boy Pocket, and nightInvert flips the field dark for a dark-theme surface without inventing a new green.
prose.typography: Press Start 2P is the cartridge voice — headings, buttons, HUD labels, menu rows, and the hero wordmark — always uppercase and tracked out 0.05em–0.15em, never longer than a few words. VT323 carries every sentence: body copy, table cells, help text, and input values at 20px/1.4 minimum, because the 8px pixel face shreds at paragraph length. Both faces are monospaced and grid-locked, so line-heights land on 4px increments and hierarchy comes from size and shade, never from faked italics or weights.
prose.layout: The layout is a fixed sprite grid: 4px sub-steps inside an 8px grid, spacing tokens of 4/8/16/24/32px, and panels aligned to those columns instead of optically nudged. Content lives inside the handheld frame — title band on top, the LCD field in the middle, a 32px status line at the bottom — so the interface reads as a screen inside a device instead of a web page. Nothing floats outside the bezel, no gutter is smaller than the 4px border weight, and every text block starts on a grid line so the dot matrix stays continuous behind it.
prose.elevation: Depth is drawn, not lit: elevation is a zero-blur hard offset shadow — 4px 4px 0 #306230 for buttons and rows, 8px 8px 0 #306230 for hero panels — and pressing an element translates it by that offset while the shadow collapses to nothing. Panels add an inset ring (inset 0 0 0 4px #8bac0f) so the field and its frame read as two LCD bezel steps. The only tolerated blur in the system is the 0 0 6px #8bac0f focus halo, used once per screen on the active control.
prose.shapes: Every shape is a square-cornered rectangle: radius 0, 4px borders, no pills, no arcs, no circles except pixels drawn as boxes. Icons, sprites, and any illustration are pixel art rendered with image-rendering: pixelated at integer scale factors (2x, 3x, 4x) so no anti-aliased edge appears, and a corner is chamfered by deleting whole 4px blocks rather than rounding it. Dividers are 4px solid or 4px dashed rules in #306230, and the caret is a solid 8px block — the only oblong in the system.
prose.components: Panels are the default container: 4px #0f380f border, inset #8bac0f ring, hard 4px offset drop, dot-matrix overlay at 100% cover with pointer-events none, and a 10px Press Start 2P title with a 4px underline. Buttons are 4px-bordered inverted plates (#0f380f fill, #9bbc0f label) whose offset shadow collapses on :active, and whose hover only moves them two pixels rather than changing shade. Inputs are VT323 wells in #8bac0f with an inset shade and a blinking block caret; the status bar is a 32px strip split by 4px rules where the live value inverts; menus are vertical Press Start 2P rows whose selected row inverts and prefixes a blinking ».
prose.dosDonts: Do keep to the four shades, do invert rather than tint, do snap every edge to 4px and every column to 8px, and do pair each inverted state with a marker glyph. Don't add a fifth green, don't blur a shadow, don't round a corner, don't set a paragraph in Press Start 2P, and don't reach for red or green status colour — the panel only has olive, so say ERROR in words.
